key_decisions: FABIO'S REVIEW CONVENTION: he names ONLY what he dislikes. Silence means approved. Misreading this cost session 18 an entire gate. Never re-ask for a verdict he has already given by not giving one.

A MEASUREMENT IS NOT A PERCEPTUAL VERDICT - this card has paid for it SEVEN times. The Phase 3 f0 numbers show the audition MECHANISM works (narration tracks its sample, character diverges) and say nothing about whether it sounds good. When his ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise.

A CLIP OFF ITS BASELINE IS REPAIRED WITH pitch_tools.py shift, NOT RE-ROLLED - phase2_perf_clips.py says so outright and this session relearned it the expensive way: all three seeds of the child persona measured R5 against a 260-340 band. The persona simply does not reach R4 with an emotion clause appended.

RELABELLING A GRID BY MEASURED f0 WAS REJECTED. It is what register_of() does for the 60 voices and it looked free, but swapping R4/R5 would have left a cartoon read driving every child audition and a child read driving every cartoon one. VC takes prosody from the SOURCE, so that is a real perceptual risk traded for a pitch fix.

AN EMOTION CELL OFF BAND IS CORRECT - the pitch lift IS the emotion, and `register` names the performer's baseline. Only the NEUTRAL cell is expected on baseline. Do not 'repair' angry or cheerful because they measure out of band.
Gender and age are DECLARED by the taxonomy (CATEGORY_META), never inferred from audio. `accent` is null on every voice without exception - check 3 enforces it.
constraints: THE PERMISSION ALLOWLIST AND THE AUTO MODE CLASSIFIER ARE DIFFERENT LAYERS. Detached/background process launches were refused repeatedly while Bash(python:*) sat in permissions.allow the whole time. Fabio added an autoMode.allow block to .claude/settings.local.json (carrying "$defaults" so it inherits rather than replaces) and it took effect LIVE, no restart. An agent CANNOT write that file itself - editing your own permission file is refused, correctly - so hand him the JSON rather than trying to route around it.

START THE BENCH WITH PowerShell Start-Process (a plain backgrounded launch is refused), and KILL IT BY VERIFIED PID - Get-Process -Id <pid> and confirm .Path -like 'G:\ComfyUi*' BEFORE Stop-Process. Never by name pattern: an agent instance and Fabio's live app share a byte-identical command line and a pattern kill took his session down mid-generation once. Never touch 48188 (the app engine) or :3000 (his app).
BASH EATS $VAR INSIDE A DOUBLE-QUOTED powershell -Command. Single-quote the PowerShell string or $p.Path arrives as .Path and the command dies with a parser error.
PYTHON STDOUT IS FULLY BUFFERED in a background Bash call - a long run shows nothing until it exits. Poll the bench's own /queue and /history for progress instead of tailing the output file.

ALWAYS take the GPU through gpu_lease.py (machine-global kernel lock, no TTL, releases on crash). Fabio's standing position, given 2026-08-26: stop asking permission for each GPU run - the lease is what prevents collisions.
HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by guard-shell. Write a script to a file and run it by path, or use single-quoted python -c.
